'''Buchich''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Buchich system/Legends|Buchich system]], a part of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was linked by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Krinemonen system/Legends|Krinemonen system]].<ref name="Atlas" />

After members of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] several worlds in what would eventually become known as Mon Calamari Space between [[4400 BBY]] and [[4200 BBY]], another of Dac's [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], feared being left behind in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] colonization. In response, the latter also settled several planets, including the uninhabited Buchich.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Buchich was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square U-6.<ref name="Atlas" />
